name: Camera pushes in
text: The camera pushes in toward her.
desc: Growing attention. The generated form of a push - real parallax, unlike the post-tier crop, because the model re-renders the geometry.
verdict: RENDERED 2026-08-04, 3 seeds, watched. Motion 3.017/5.592/4.389 - it moves, 3/3. BUT THE SUBJECT SURVIVES ONLY 1/3: on 7701 it settles into a clean medium-close on her face; on 7702 the frame is a blur past her by f96; on 7703 she is gone entirely and the clip ends on an empty table. It also pushes far LESS than motion_probe's scene-anchored version - creep 1.05/1.05/1.10 here against 1.40/1.45/1.07 for 'pushes in past the pillar'. Naming a concrete landmark in the path beats naming the subject. Use on short beats. NOTE: this asks the video model to move the camera while effects.json's `camera` variable crops the finished clip - the two layers compound. Band 0.406-0.744 (empty control 0.628); frame-scale ceiling 1.191.
